svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Gallery · item view · a preview · downloading the originals · 1310×800
svg.desc: Mirrors the preview page's status card AS PROGRESS in the Mac's Gallery item view (plan §4.2 / §8 / §9, §16; new 2026-09-26): after 'Download and Continue' for Light (gallery.item.preview.prompt.svg) — or the card's own Download — EditorPreviewPage.status answers the download first (picplace.progress[id].phase == .downloading, stage 1's ordering fix): glyph `.cloud(.downloading)` — icloud.and.arrow.down.fill in LL.accent, the light palette's amber for 'moving' (§16; the SF symbol hangs its arrowhead under the cloud, drawn here as the pill set's cloud with the arrow knocked out); title 'Downloading \(noun.text)' → 'Downloading the originals' (one line: 163.6 of the 188.5 pt beside Stop); the caption '\(bytesDone) of \(bytesTotal)' plus, with a resume group, ' · \(group) opens when \(pronoun) \(verb) here' → '486,2 MB of 1,16 GB · Light opens when they are here', two lines; under it ProgressView(value: 0.419).tint(LL.accent), 2 pt below the caption — macOS 26's bar, measured on the 2026-09-25 bench capture of this card: a 20 pt frame with an 8 pt track (black 6 %) across the whole text column (the bar stretches the VStack to its 188.5 pt), the 6 pt fill inset a point top and bottom (the capture's fill is grey: a driver-launched window is inactive); the action 'Stop' 13 pt semibold LL.accent (picplace.cancelSync, drops resume). 298 × 96 at y 237 (the capture's two-line photo title made it 112: the same arithmetic). Before the first byte the caption is '1,16 GB to download' (no ' · Light opens …' — that rides only the 'of' line), before PicPlace has listed the files 'Asking PicPlace for the files…'; a download started by the card's own Download has no group, so no ' · Light opens …'. Non-blocking: the inspector, the filmstrip and ← → all still work, and moving on leaves the download running. THE FILMSTRIP'S TILE 8 wears holdings-pill.there.downloading (grey camera · amber ↓) while it runs — drawn over the strip component here (its tile art, the pill as a component reference at 0.8, the ring), since components/gallery-filmstrip.preview.svg draws the tile at rest; the grid's tile, the inspector's PICPLACE card and the Project Syncing drawer's 'Downloading from PicPlace' block show the same run. When the last file lands (checkArrival), PhotoViewerView replaces the page in this column with the Light panel open (EditorPageRequest.group → the editor's pendingPanel) — the rail becomes gallery.item.interval.svg's with Light open. Everything else as gallery.item.preview.svg. THE ITEM VIEW is gallery.item.svg's — the inspector column (GalleryPreviewPanel .inspector, 330 pt), the item header (▤ · ‹ Gallery · the name · 'n of N'), the editor column (the media beside the fixed 330 pt rail) and the filmstrip under everything, the floating tab bar — and GalleryItemEditor (App/GalleryItemView.swift) puts EditorPreviewPage in the editor's place when the focus request's asset is `.preview`: GalleryView.enterItem / move(to:) / step stage every project with `stageEditor(for:page:allowsPreview: true)`, so a preview opens, and the filmstrip and ← → walk straight through previews (they stalled on one until 2026-09-25). The page is its own view (EditorPreviewPageContent, plan T6), built from the editor's components with a `locked` state — never the editor mounted on a poster, so it has no write path (no persist net, no white migration, no as-shot reads). SAMPLE: tile 8 of gallery.svg's grid — the interval drawn there with holdings-pill.there.safe (a preview: its originals removed here, PicPlace holds them, the ✓ stays) — 8 of 14, an unnamed shoot, so its displayTitle is the dated 'Stack 7. 9. at 21:40' (the window title and the header both carry it); 214 JPEG originals (3024 × 4032 — INFO's Size), 1,16 GB recorded in assets.ndjson; the grade is a record, so the dots of Presets and Light still show. LAYOUT (App/EditorPreviewPage.swift railBody, the Mac's only dressing): the picture pane — black, the whole 648 × 568 column (no timeline strip, no full-screen button, no marquee badge: the badge is the dark card's) — with poster.jpg as it is (previewPictureURL; graded when it was made, never graded again), scaledToFit and centred: 426 × 568 at x 462; a Divider; the rail, a ScrollView padded 14 / 16 / 20 with 12 between — RailTabBar (App/RailTabBar.swift, locked: Text · Frames · Masks accent at 38 %, Editor selected), EditorGroupBar (.macCard, locked: every cell #6D6D72 at 42 %, none selected, the dots LL.accent at 55 %), then statusCard(style: .light) at y 237 — LL.cardBackground, radius 16, padding 12, no badge. Every greyed control stays clickable and ASKS (a click on a locked page → ask(.tab), a group → ask(.group), the card itself → ask(.line), subject 'Editing'). macOS rounds each Text frame up to the whole point (measured: the stage-1 captures' cards are 57 and 85 pt, exactly the rounded sums), so the rest card is 85 pt where the unrounded arithmetic says 83.7. HOOKS: `LL_DROP_SOURCES=<uuid>` on a Mac scratch root (`-storage.libraryRootPath`) in one launch renders poster.jpg and deletes the originals — with no server the card then reads the `.unavailable` offer ('The originals aren't on this Mac', the slashed camera, no Download) — and `LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid>` in the next opens the item view on the page; the on-PicPlace reading drawn here needs the PicPlace bench (a bound scratch root, `LL_PICPLACE_TOKENS` always): upload, `LL_PICPLACE_REMOVE=<uuid>:originals`, then `LL_TAB=gallery LL_ITEM=<uuid>`. `LL_PREVIEW_PROMPT=light` raises the prompt 1.2 s after the page appears, `light:download` presses Download and Continue two seconds later; a driver-launched Mac instance is pressed through accessibility, never the pointer — `~/Library/Developer/LetsLapseRun/tools/ax press <pid> '*' AXButton 'Download and Continue'`; `LL_PICPLACE_TRANSFER_OUTAGE=0:20` holds the download long enough to see its progress. Geometry from the code, checked against the Mac Debug captures of 2026-09-25 (a photo preview in this item view — before §16's glyphs and today's copy: its words and glyphs come from the code, its seats from the captures).
svg.text: macOS · Gallery · item view · a preview — the card as progress, downloading the originals · 1310×800 pt window
mirrors EditorPreviewPage status (progress) + statusCard(.light) — Stop · LL_PREVIEW_PROMPT=light:download on the PicPlace bench
